name: ghidra-bizhawk-mcp
description: Unified Ghidra + BizHawk MCP server for static analysis, P-code emulation, multi-console ROM triage, and live emulation.
long_description:
Connects Ghidra's headless static analysis with BizHawk's live emulation for retro-reversing and firmware analysis. Supports NES, SNES, GBA, NDS, Switch, PSX, Genesis, SMS, Dreamcast and more.

**Features:**
- Decompilation, disassembly, byte search, and binary diffing
- P-code micro-emulation via Ghidra's EmulatorHelper
- Function fingerprinting and signature transfer
- Live BizHawk emulation control (memory read/write, joypad, frame advance, save states)
- Retro console platform detection by magic bytes

ghidra_install_dir.title: Ghidra Installation Directory
ghidra_install_dir.description: Path to your Ghidra installation (e.g. C:\Program Files\ghidra_11.2 or /opt/ghidra)

bizhawk_exe_path.title: BizHawk Emulator Path
bizhawk_exe_path.description: Optional path to EmuHawk.exe for live emulation. Leave blank for Ghidra-only mode.

mock_mode.title: Mock Mode
mock_mode.description: Enable mock mode for zero-dependency environments (disables Ghidra/BizHawk connections)

tools.name: analyze_binary
tools.description: Import and analyze a binary into a named session

binary_path.description: Absolute file path to the target binary for headless static analysis and import.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Reuses existing session if provided, auto-generates a fresh one if omitted.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List all active session workspaces with their IDs, binary paths, and load times.

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: Close and remove a session workspace, freeing its Ghidra project resources.

session_id.description: Identifier of the session to close and remove from the workspace registry.

tools.name: decompile_function
tools.description: Decompile a function by name or address into human-readable C code.

function_name.description: Function name (e.g., 'main') or hex address (e.g., '0x08000100') to decompile.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: decompile_function_paginated
tools.description: Decompile a function with configurable line range and token-budget truncation to prevent context-window exhaustion.

function_name.description: Function name or hex address to decompile.

line_start.description: Starting line number for paginated output (0-indexed, inclusive).

line_end.description: Ending line number for paginated output (exclusive).

max_tokens.description: Maximum token budget for the decompiled output; truncates when exceeded.

summarize.description: When true, strips boilerplate local variable declarations and collapses blank lines for a condensed view.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: get_data_types
tools.description: List all data types defined in the loaded program, including structures, unions, enums, and typedefs.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: get_cross_references
tools.description: Get cross-references to and from a specified memory address.

address.description: Memory address in hex format (e.g., '0x08000100') to query for cross-references.

max_results.description: Maximum number of cross-reference results to return.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: get_call_graph
tools.description: Get the recursive call graph for a function, including both callees and callers.

function_name.description: Function name or hex address to generate the call graph for.

max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth for call graph traversal.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: analyze_and_decompile_entrypoints
tools.description: Bulk decompile all entry points (program entry, exports, main, _start, etc.) in a single call.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: rename_symbol
tools.description: Rename a function or label at a given address. Changes persist in the Ghidra project database.

address.description: Memory address of the symbol to rename in hex format (e.g., '0x08000100').

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Attach a comment to a code unit at a specified address.

address.description: Memory address of the code unit to annotate in hex format.

text.description: Comment text content to attach to the code unit.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: create_struct
tools.description: Create a custom structured data type from a JSON member layout definition.

name.description: Name for the new data type (e.g., 'PlayerState').

members.description: Array of member definitions: [{'offset': 0, 'name': 'hp', 'type': 'int'}, ...]. Offsets are optional and auto-calculated if omitted.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: retype_variable
tools.description: Change a local variable or function parameter type to a new data type.

address.description: Address of the function containing the variable to retype.

variable_name.description: Name of the local variable or function parameter to retype.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: disassemble_range
tools.description: Disassemble a specified number of raw instructions at a given address.

address.description: Starting memory address for disassembly in hex format.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: search_bytes
tools.description: Search the entire binary for a hex byte pattern and return matching addresses with context.

pattern.description: Hex byte pattern to search for. Space-separated or continuous (e.g., '09 08 00 01' or 'F86D0003').

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching addresses to return.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: get_listing_range
tools.description: Return a raw hex dump with ASCII representation for a byte range, equivalent to Ghidra's Listing panel.

start_address.description: Starting memory address for the hex dump in hex format.

byte_count.description: Number of bytes to dump starting from the start address.

columns.description: Number of hex columns per row in the output display.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: diff_binaries
tools.description: Compare two loaded sessions by function name and body size, returning functions unique to each side and changed functions.

session_a.description: Session identifier for the first binary to compare.

session_b.description: Session identifier for the second binary to compare.

tools.name: generate_workspace_report
tools.description: Produce a comprehensive Markdown summary of the active workspace including entry points, function count, custom symbols, and comments.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: emulate_slice
tools.description: Headlessly execute N instructions using Ghidra's P-code EmulatorHelper with configurable initial register state and register tracking.

start_address.description: Starting memory address for emulation in hex format.

instruction_count.description: Maximum number of instructions to emulate before stopping.

initial_registers.description: Initial register state as a dict of register names to values (e.g., {'r0': 0, 'sp': 0x1000}).

track_registers.description: List of register names to track and report at each emulation step (e.g., ['r0', 'r1', 'pc']).

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: emulate_slice_with_taint
tools.description: Execute instructions with automated taint tracking on a specified register, flagging when its value is modified or propagates.

start_address.description: Starting memory address for emulation in hex format.

instruction_count.description: Maximum number of instructions to emulate before stopping.

initial_registers.description: Initial register state as a dict of register names to values.

taint_register.description: Register name to track for taint propagation (e.g., 'r0'). The tool flags every instruction where its value is modified.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: emulate_slice_with_breakpoints
tools.description: Execute instructions until a register condition is met or the instruction count expires.

start_address.description: Starting memory address for emulation in hex format.

instruction_count.description: Maximum number of instructions to emulate before giving up.

initial_registers.description: Initial register state as a dict of register names to values.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: calculate_function_fingerprint
tools.description: Generate a structural hash for a function based on its variables, parameters, body size, branches, called functions, embedded strings, and numeric constants.

func_name.description: Function name or hex address to fingerprint.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: export_signature_map
tools.description: Build a complete hash-to-name signature map for every function in the current binary for reuse across versions.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: apply_signature_map
tools.description: Match functions by fingerprint against a previously exported signature map and automatically rename all matches.

signature_json_map.description: Previously exported signature map JSON object mapping hashes to function names.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: save_active_binary_signature
tools.description: Fingerprint all functions and stash the signature map server-side under a lineage group identifier.

lineage_group_id.description: Identifier for the signature stash group (e.g., 'my_firmware_v1'). Maps are stored in ~/.ghidra_bizhawk_mcp/signatures/.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: auto_restore_signatures_from_stash
tools.description: Load a stashed signature map by lineage group ID and auto-rename every matching function in the current binary.

lineage_group_id.description: Identifier for the signature stash group to restore from the server-side cache.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: auto_stash_current_binary
tools.description: Zero-input auto-stash: hashes the binary's first 4 KB and saves a fingerprint map under that content hash.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: auto_restore_current_binary
tools.description: Zero-input auto-restore: hashes the binary, looks up a previous stash by content hash, and renames matches automatically.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier. Uses the most recently active session if omitted.

tools.name: list_stashed_signature_groups
tools.description: List all stashed signature groups currently in the local server-side cache.

tools.name: triage_and_load_retro_rom
tools.description: Detect retro console architecture from ROM magic bytes, load with correct Ghidra language module, and auto-restore cached signatures.

rom_path.description: Absolute path to the ROM file for architecture detection and loading. Supports NES, SNES, GBA, NDS, Switch, PSX, Genesis, SMS, Dreamcast.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier for the provisioned Ghidra session.

tools.name: bizhawk_connect
tools.description: Check TCP connectivity to the BizHawk emulator bridge for live emulation control.

tools.name: bizhawk_get_info
tools.description: Retrieve ROM metadata and emulator capabilities from the connected BizHawk instance.

tools.name: bizhawk_list_memory_domains
tools.description: List all available memory domains exposed by the BizHawk emulator core.

tools.name: bizhawk_read_memory
tools.description: Read a range of bytes from the BizHawk emulated memory at a specified address and domain.

address.description: Memory address to read from, as an unsigned integer offset within the specified domain.

size.description: Number of bytes to read from the specified address.

domain.description: Memory domain name to read from (e.g., 'WRAM', 'IWRAM', 'System Bus', 'CART'). Uses the default domain if omitted.

tools.name: bizhawk_write_memory
tools.description: Write an array of byte values to the BizHawk emulated memory at a specified address and domain.

address.description: Memory address to write to, as an unsigned integer offset within the specified domain.

data.description: Array of byte values (0-255) to write sequentially starting at the specified address.

domain.description: Memory domain name to write to (e.g., 'WRAM', 'IWRAM', 'System Bus', 'CART'). Uses the default domain if omitted.

tools.name: bizhawk_press_buttons
tools.description: Set joypad button states for a specified player in the BizHawk emulator.

buttons.description: Dict of button names to boolean pressed states (e.g., {'A': true, 'B': false, 'Up': true, 'Start': true}).

player.description: Player number (1-indexed) for multi-player scenarios. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: bizhawk_frame_advance
tools.description: Advance the BizHawk emulator by a specified number of frames.

count.description: Number of emulation frames to advance. Each frame executes one full frame of the emulated system.

tools.name: bizhawk_pause
tools.description: Pause the currently running BizHawk emulation.

tools.name: bizhawk_unpause
tools.description: Unpause a previously paused BizHawk emulation session.

tools.name: bizhawk_reset
tools.description: Reset the loaded emulator core in BizHawk, equivalent to a hardware reset.

tools.name: bizhawk_screenshot
tools.description: Capture and save a PNG screenshot of the current BizHawk emulator display to a file.

path.description: Absolute file path where the PNG screenshot will be saved.

tools.name: bizhawk_save_state
tools.description: Save the current BizHawk emulator state to a file for later restoration.

path.description: Absolute file path where the emulator state will be saved.

tools.name: bizhawk_load_state
tools.description: Load a previously saved BizHawk emulator state from a file and restore emulation to that point.

path.description: Absolute file path to the saved emulator state file to load.

tools.name: bizhawk_launch
tools.description: Launch the BizHawk emulator application, load the specified ROM, and establish the bridge connection.

rom_path.description: Absolute path to the ROM file for BizHawk to load and begin emulating.
